question: Tanjore Balasaraswati was a well-known ______ dancer.
solution:
The famous dancer T Balasaraswati was an exponent of __Bharatanatyam.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

 
• Bharatanatyam is a classical dance style that originated in Tamil Nadu's South Indian state, making this dance style well known in various parts of India and many parts of the world.
 
• In 1957 she was awarded the Padma Bhushan and in 1977 the Padma Vibhushan.
 
• She received the Sangeetha Kalasikhamani Award from The Indian Fine Arts Society, Chennai, in 1981.
 
• She was the only non-western dancer included in a Dance Heritage Coalition compilation, "The Irreplaceable Treasures of Dance in America: The First 100" (2000).
 
• Satyajit Ray, a Bengali film director, made a documentary film on Balasaraswati called Bala (1976).
